title: 高收入人群调整退休储蓄配置 不再满额缴存401(k)
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: One of the stories that caught our audience's attention this week is whether to maximize your contributions to 401Ks because some high earners are now questioning that strategy.
segments.zh: 本周吸引观众注意的一个话题是，是否要最大化401K缴款，因为一些高收入者现在质疑这一策略。

segments.en: Bloomberg star Foster has been reporting on the story and she joins us now to discuss and you talk to a 40-year-old who decided to cut her contribution down to 5% from 20% so
segments.zh: 彭博明星记者福斯特一直在报道此事，现在她加入我们讨论。你采访了一位40岁女性，她决定将缴款从20%降至5%，所以

segments.en: she can still capture her full employer match but she no longer wants to put that other amount into her 401K.
segments.zh: 她仍能获得雇主全额匹配，但不再想把多余金额投入401K。

segments.en: She's redirecting it elsewhere. It's been months, I think, of writing stories about Macsars.
segments.zh: 她将资金转向其他方向。我想，写关于Macsars的报道已经好几个月了。

segments.en: I guess it's time that we write a story about anti-macsars.
segments.zh: 我想是时候写一篇关于反Macsars的报道了。

segments.en: I spoke with one of these savers who told me that she's still saving and investing for her future.
segments.zh: 我与其中一位储蓄者交谈，她告诉我她仍在为未来储蓄和配置。

segments.en: She's just not putting it in the 401K. She's looking at the Roth IRA, brokerages.
segments.zh: 她只是不把钱放在401K里。她正在考虑Roth IRA和经纪账户。

segments.en: She wants access to the funds earlier and she wants more control over her investments.
segments.zh: 她希望更早获得资金，并希望对自己的配置有更多控制权。

segments.en: And if she were to put it in her 401K, she would be penalized if she took her money out early.
segments.zh: 如果她将钱投入401K，提前取出会被罚款。

segments.en: So this is for people who want to work hard, save hard and retire early.
segments.zh: 所以这是为那些想努力工作、努力储蓄并提前退休的人准备的。

segments.en: Yes, it's one of those stories where I think finance has to kind of fit around your personal goals and so if you're someone who maybe wants to take on a little more risk or maybe
segments.zh: 是的，这类故事说明财务规划要围绕个人目标来安排。如果你愿意承担更多风险，或者想提前退休，那就另当别论。

segments.en: retire early before those typical rules with the traditional 401K, that's when it probably makes sense to Macs out, not to not Macs out, excuse me, but I think the big question
segments.zh: 想比传统401K规则更早退休，那可能适合多缴一些。但关键问题是，现在许多退休规划师对此有些担忧。

segments.en: now is a lot of retirement planners are a little bit worried about it.
segments.zh: 我并不担心。与彼得·奥斯泽格多年前在布鲁金斯学会的里程碑研究相比，变化在于我相信我们都在活得更久。

segments.en: I was not worried about it. The thing that's changed from Peter Orszeg and his landmark work at Brookings years ago is I believe we're all living longer.
segments.zh: 我并不担心。与彼得·奥萨格多年前在布鲁金斯学会的里程碑式研究相比，变化在于我相信我们都在活得更久。
